metadata.description: 18 Claude Code commands for development and workflow management. Two installable plugin packs by WhateverAI.

plugins.name: whateverai-dev-skills
plugins.description: 8 essential development commands that work in any project: build, test, debug, refactor, review, document, deploy-check, security-scan. Zero setup required. Multi-ecosystem support (Node.js, Python, Go, Rust). Use when you need reliable development workflow commands that auto-detect your project's stack.

plugins.name: whateverai-workflow-skills
plugins.description: 10 opinionated workflow commands for structured project management: plan, resume, recover, sync, status, init, align, catalog, do, plan-linear. Includes smart skill routing (/do), session crash recovery (/recover), skills catalog (/catalog), and optional Linear integration. Use when you want a structured planning and progress tracking system for Claude Code projects.
